name: Utah

windshield.strip: windshield must allow at least 70% light transmittance; nontransparent material allowed along the top edge down to 4 in. from the top or the AS-1 line, whichever is lowest; also lower left corner up to 3 in. right x 4 in. high
windshield.reflective: no metallic or mirrored appearance on any window

frontSide.note: no more than a 5% variance observed by a peace officer metering the light transmittance

backSide.note: nontransparent materials may be used on rear side windows behind the operator; left and right mirrors required

rear.note: left and right rear-view mirrors required when any window (other than the windshield strip) is tinted

tint.measuredHow: not stated ('a front side window that allows less than 35% light transmittance' - i.e. the window as a whole)
tint.dualMirrors: Required (left and right) for a vehicle with tinting or nontransparent material on any window other than the permitted windshield areas

medicalExemption.text: No medical exemption appears in the current text of 41-6a-1635; not verified elsewhere

penalty.text: Infraction; selling/installing non-compliant tint also prohibited; officers may not seek license/registration suspension for windshield or front-side tint violations

tint.lastAmended: 2025 (Chapter 205, 2025 General Session, effective 5/7/2025); the 35% front-side figure was already in the 2022 version
quotes: a windshield that allows less than 70% light transmittance
a front side window that allows less than 35% light transmittance, with no more than a 5% variance observed by a peace officer metering the light transmittance
along the top edge of the windshield if the materials do not extend downward more than four inches from the top edge of the windshield or beyond the AS-1 line whichever is lowest
on the rear windows including rear side windows located behind the vehicle operator
A violation of this section is an infraction.

helmet.conditions: Under 21 on a motorcycle, non-enclosed autocycle, e-bike, motor assisted scooter or high power electric device; max fine $110 (motorcycle)

handheldPhone.fineText: Manual texting, dialing, internet, photo/video, data entry banned (voice calls allowed); class C misdemeanor, max $100; class B if serious injury or prior conviction within 3 years

studdedTires.season: Oct 15 - Mar 31 (tungsten carbide studs, max .050 in. protrusion; vehicles up to 9,000 lb GVWR except emergency vehicles/school buses)

radarDetector.note: No state ban found; commercial vehicles over 10,001 lb banned federally (49 CFR 392.71)

openQuestions: Medical exemption: none in statute; DPS rules not checked
Tint infraction fine amount not stated
Primary enforcement of phone law assumed (no secondary clause in text)
Underglow and lift rules not located
